latest.title: Build Your First AI Agent on AWS (in about the time it takes to drink a coffee)
latest.description: An LLM answers; an agent acts. In this hands-on walkthrough from a 30-minute meetup talk, I build an AWS Cost Explainer agent live: the whole thing is a model, one tool, and a loop you don't have to write. We use Strands for the agent, Kiro's spec-driven flow to go from plain English to working code, and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore as the runtime. Full sample code, a clone-and-run repo, and homework sized to where you are. Come build your first agent.

latest.title: Build a Serverless REST API on AWS with Lambda, API Gateway, and DynamoDB
latest.description: Managing servers is the part of building an API that most developers enjoy least. Patching, scaling, and paying for idle capacity all take time away from the actual product. In this article, we'll build a simple serverless REST API on AWS that stores and retrieves notes, with no servers to manage.

latest.title: Teaching an AI Agent to Do Quantum: Inside the Amazon Braket Skill
latest.description: The amazon-braket skill teaches an AI agent to run quantum workflows on Amazon Braket — it's pure markdown (no code), pairing expert guidance with the Braket Python SDK and a generic AWS proxy. This post covers what it can do, why the skill-plus-proxy architecture trades a little determinism for broad coverage and free local work, and why it's a natural fit for hands-on training and workshops: start free, cap spend before touching a QPU, and let the agent explain as it works.

latest.title: Ai AWS
latest.description: This markdown article expands on the concept of an AWS financial "kill switch." It outlines the anxiety surrounding accidental cloud bills, explains why current passive budgeting alerts are insufficient for students and hobbyists, and details how a native account hard-cap mechanism would work. Finally, it presents a compelling case for why this safety valve would ultimately benefit AWS by fostering fearless developer adoption and reducing customer support overhead.Would you like me to convert this article
